summary: Verified 4 follow-up changes on the Add-on Orders feature (Iter77): (1) new RBAC permissions addon.view/addon.manage are present in the Access Control catalog as DIRECT actions (no approval/request keys) and included in super admin navigation permissions; (2) admin action-center returns key='addon_orders' with count>=3, link=/admin/addon-orders, permission=addon.view — and the corresponding card 'Layanan tambahan menunggu dikerjakan' renders on /admin/dashboard linking to /admin/addon-orders; (3) product catalog CRUD moved off /admin/payments (admin-payment-products removed) and now lives at /admin/addon-orders as admin-addon-catalog with delivery_type select; create/patch/delete verified via UI+API, invalid delivery_type via PATCH rejected 400; catalog endpoints correctly gated by addon.view / addon.manage; (4) delivery modal branches on delivery_type: Visualizer (file) shows admin-addon-delivery-file picker only, Link Preset (link) shows admin-addon-delivery-url only. Backend POST /api/admin/addon-orders/{id}/delivery-file uploads, sets status='delivered', delivery_url=/api/files/…, delivery_filename; rejects unsupported extension (400) and cancelled order (409). Label /label/dashboard renders 'Layanan Tambahan' with Buka/Unduh link. All 7 pytest tests pass; UI E2E flows all green.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_upload_delivery_file: filename extension check is fine, but consider size limit (currently unbounded — storage_service.upload_fileobj streams the whole file). Add a max_size check to prevent abuse.
admin_upload_delivery_file: content_type is taken directly from client without validation — combined with the extension whitelist this is acceptable but noting for defense-in-depth.
AddonOrders.jsx: catalog+orders in single ~260 line page is still within limits; if it grows further, split catalog section into its own component.
payments.py admin_update_product: only rejects invalid delivery_type in the update path but never asserts a value is provided; existing behavior — acceptable.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Test-created product TEST_UI_iter77 was deleted. Backend test's cancellation of a demo Link Preset order was reverted via mongosh back to 'pending' so demo seed is intact. Note: Landscape visualizer demo order is now 'delivered' (from valid E2E file-upload test) — expected side-effect showing the delivered link works.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All follow-up asks verified. Demo state after test: Visualizer Landscape=delivered (with test result.mp4), Visualizer Portrait=in_progress, Link Preset=pending. If future test wants a pending Visualizer, use POST /api/admin/addon-orders/backfill or manually reset via mongosh.
